UpdateSourceData:
# Generated by AMP on every start. Changes made here are lost: use the AMP settings, or conf.d/custom.conf.
allow_anonymous {{AllowAnonymous}}
password_file {{$FullBaseDir}}passwords.txt
persistence {{SaveBrokerState}}
persistence_location {{$FullBaseDir}}data/
log_dest stderr
log_type error
log_type warning
log_type notice
log_type information
{{VerboseLogging}}log_type all
connection_messages {{ConnectionMessages}}
include_dir {{$FullBaseDir}}conf.d

listener {{$ServerPort}} {{$ApplicationIPBinding}}
protocol mqtt

{{WebSocketsListener}}listener {{$WebSocketPort}} {{$ApplicationIPBinding}}
{{WebSocketsListener}}protocol websockets

UpdateSourceArgs: -NoProfile -Command "$User = '{{MqttUsername}}'; $Password = '{{MqttPassword}}'; if ($User) { if (-not $Password) { Write-Output 'A password is required for the MQTT user. Skipping'; exit 0 }; & '{{$FullBaseDir}}mosquitto_passwd.exe' -b '{{$FullBaseDir}}passwords.txt' $User $Password }"

-c "u='{{MqttUsername}}'; p='{{MqttPassword}}'; [ -z \"$u\" ] && exit 0; [ -z \"$p\" ] && { echo 'A password is required for the MQTT user. Skipping'; exit 0; }; mosquitto_passwd -b '{{$FullBaseDir}}passwords.txt' \"$u\" \"$p\""
